test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In July 2021, which Union Territory of India launched ‘Tejaswini’ ________ an initiative centred around women empowerment and safety?
solution:
The correct answer is__ **Delhi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to police officials, the **Tejaswini initiative**, which was started to reduce crimes against women in **Delhi**, has produced excellent results.
 
• **TEJASWINI: Women Centric Safety & Empowerment Initiative**" was the name given to this project by the North-West District.
 
• The launch date was **July 10, 2021**.
 
• In the crime-ridden and sensitive beat districts of several police stations, **46 women-beat** constables were placed.
 
• Its** objectives** included reaching out to women from all social classes and older women as well as defending the rights and dignity of women and children in the North-West District.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The** Tejaswini programme **was launched in order to establish an environment where women would feel comfortable talking to these female constables and sharing their problems and worries.
 
• After** three months** of putting the programme into operation, a variety of gatherings, conversations, and open house events with women and female constables were arranged to assess the situation on the ground.
 
• The** main goal** of this activity or project is to raise awareness of the trends of various crimes against women, such as molestation, rape, sexual assault, domestic violence, child abuse, and harassment for dowry demand, among others, among women and girls of all age groups and their guardians/parents.
 
• It sought to give students the confidence to handle difficult and undesirable situations on their own while simultaneously educating them on how to get **legal assistance**.
